.ffx2hud .ig-stat-list.body: left: auto; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; align-items: flex-end; gap: 3px; --ig-stat-step: 4px;

.ffx2hud .ig-stat.body: width: 158px; height: 28px; gap: 4px; padding-right: 6px; align-items: center;

.ffx2stat__face.body: position: relative; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: 2px; overflow: hidden; background: #1a1526; border: 0.75px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ffx2-job, var(--ig-accent)) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 1.5px;

.ig-stat--acting .ffx2stat__face.body: border-color: var(--ig-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ig-accent) 55%, transparent);

.ffx2stat__mono.body: position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--ig-font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ffx2-job, var(--ig-accent));

.ffx2stat__job.body: position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 0 1.5px; font-family: var(--ig-font-display); font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; font-size: 5.5px; line-height: 8px; color: #12101c; background: var(--ffx2-job, var(--ig-accent)); border-radius: 0 1.5px 0 0;

.ffx2stat__body.body: flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2.5px;

.ffx2stat__top.body: display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; min-width: 0;

.ffx2party__status.body: display: flex; gap: 1.5px; margin-left: auto; overflow: hidden;
